purpose: Portable consultancy methodology for building durable, dependency-aware, AI-enabled organizational operating systems.
next_action: Complete the remaining reusable M04 client control-plane bootstrap kit artifacts: generic client plan, runbook, worklog, authority/source model, adoption-status controls, and bootstrap assembly checklist. Multi-environment topology, optional Connected Discovery, terminology crosswalks, and the Method Observation queue are now registered method capabilities.
principles: Conversation is an execution surface, not the durable record.
Durable operational state must survive employee, tool, consultant, and conversation turnover.
Working planes and durable control planes have different jobs.
One information class should have one declared authority at a time.
Target accountability and current execution authority are separate.
AI may incubate functions without inheriting human organizational authority.
Consequential proposals and adopted decisions are different states.
A role-conversation launch prompt is a bootstrap pointer; live durable state and declared authoritative systems override it.
Local improvement should create global awareness without automatic global change.
Client confidentiality and portability are architectural requirements, not cleanup tasks.
Discovery escalates uncertainty rather than meetings: prove what can be proven, infer only the gaps, validate what matters, and redesign only after enough current work and authority are understood.
Working-plane topology is provider-neutral and identifies provider, tenant/account, environment, service, and location separately.
Connected discovery is optional evidence acquisition; connector access does not create information authority.
Material methodology lessons are captured durably before later triage; the observation queue does not hijack the active method cursor.

Cross-role transitions separate execution routing, durable context transfer, and authority resolution; handoffs transfer context rather than authority, and role-local chat context does not cross implicitly.
Cross-role disagreements resolve from authoritative sources first, then the owning domain, with human escalation reserved for genuine authority/adoption conflicts.

engagement_runtime.short_command_pattern: Check Tenshodo-Process and execute Engagement Step <N> for <client>.
engagement_runtime.preferred_continuation_pattern: Check Tenshodo-Process and execute the current engagement step for <client>.
engagement_runtime.repository_resolution_rule: Check PROCESS_CONTEXT.json and PROCESS_POINTER.json before reading large repository state; follow pointers to the engagement control plane.
engagement_runtime.role_binding_policy: A fresh unbound conversation may adopt the live executor. Once bound, a conversation must not silently switch to another role; a role mismatch requires handoff instructions instead of execution.
engagement_runtime.workstream_command_pattern: Check Tenshodo-Process and continue the <workstream> workstream for <client>.
engagement_runtime.workstream_resolution_rule: Resolve role binding first, then explicit workstream, role-assigned workstream, declared default, or the single remaining eligible active workstream; ask only when multiple eligible workstreams remain.
engagement_runtime.role_handoff_rule: Use a durable Role Handoff Contract when material work crosses governed roles and the successor needs shared context beyond a simple task pointer. The handoff transfers context, not authority: classify authoritative facts, adopted decisions, recommendations/hypotheses, dependencies/requests, and unknown/disputed items by source. Resolve disagreement from source hierarchy first, then route domain-owned questions, and escalate genuine authority/adoption conflicts to the valid human authority for that decision class.

commercialization.activation_rule: Activate only when real durable market-facing work exists; do not create executive role conversations solely to fill an org chart.

connected_discovery.activation_rule: Optional. Use the least intrusive acquisition profile sufficient for trustworthy discovery; default connector posture is scoped read-only.
